messages:
Aisha K.: Grafana alert firing — `trace_spans_dropped_total` high for gpu-serving pods in eu-west-1. Spikes after last midnight rollouts, lots of dropped spans. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Michael B.: Are we hitting collector backpressure or gateway header drops? Last week we had Envoy strip trace headers on http/1 upgrades.
Cheng L.: Checking the collector logs now — seeing `queue_full` and exporter retry backoffs on gpu-collector pods. Memory trending up before OOM kills. Could be sampling/multiplication issue.
Aisha K.: Dashboard: traces_per_min jumped ~6x, avg spans_in_batch ~20k, collector pod heap >1.5GB before restart.
Sam P.: FYI the k8s ingress does HTTP/2->HTTP/1 conversion for our model-streaming endpoints. That can drop `traceparent` unless explicitly whitelisted.
Michael B.: If `traceparent` is stripped, downstream services will start new root spans => huge duplication. Quick mitigation: configure ingress to preserve `traceparent` and `tracestate`.
Cheng L.: Longer term: move heavy model requests to lower sampling + tail-sampling rules that prioritize interesting traces. Proposal: 0.2% global, 5% for >1MB payloads, 100% for partner accounts / errors.
Aisha K.: Can you paste an otel-collector snippet for retries/sampling/limits?
Michael B.: Paste:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "telemetry-agg:4317"
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 5s
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
  tail_sampling:
    policy:
      - name: keep-important-models
        decision_wait: 10s
        type: numeric_attribute
        numeric_attribute:
          key: request.size
          min_value: 1048576
```
Cheng L.: Also add a `rate_limiter` processor and shard exporters per-AZ to avoid single-node export storms. Limit memory per collector pod and set `max_queue_size` on processors.
Sam P.: Ops note: deploy-bot rolled a canary for collector v2.3 at 1782502022 — ingress header whitelist change included. Seeing partial improvement :eyes:.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] canary: telemetry/gpu-collector v2.3 -> 4 pods in eu-west-1, status: progressing
Aisha K.: Action items: 1) ingress: add `traceparent,tracestate` passthrough (Sam). 2) otel: add `rate_limiter` + tail_sampling rules (Michael/Cheng). 3) dashboard: span-drop heatmap by node + model_id (me). 4) cost check: ingress->collector egress and downstream export egress (finance).
Michael B.: I’ll take the otel changes and open a PR for processor config + batching tweaks.
Cheng L.: I’ll prototype tail-sampling rules and a small sim to estimate retention/cost. Suggest default rules: 0.2% global, 5% for large requests, 100% for partner accounts & errors >=500.
Aisha K.: Thanks — created INF-2987 for tracking and will page on-call if another spike happens :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
Sam P.: I added Grafana panels: trace_ingest_lag, spans_dropped_pct, collector_heap_bytes and a small alert to mute noisy transient spikes.
Aisha K.: Great. Ping me if you need extra infra quota in eu-west or temporary exporter throttles.
